block.table_tools.model.title: Table Tools
block.table_tools.model.description: Normalize JSON or CSV tables, select columns, compare records and join unique keys without modifying source files.
block.table_tools.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.table_tools.help_operation: Normalize one table, select columns, or compare/join it with reference.
block.table_tools.help_keys: Distinct key columns, e.g. ["id"]. Required for comparison and joins.
block.table_tools.help_columns: Output columns. An empty array keeps all columns.
block.table_tools.help_column_types: Column conversions, e.g. {"quantity":"integer"}. Types: string, integer, number, boolean, json.
block.table_tools.help_allowed_root: CSV read boundary. Empty uses the application directory; relative paths start here.
block.table_tools.help_encoding: Text encoding for CSV files only.
block.table_tools.help_max_bytes: Maximum input size in bytes; decoded CSV is checked too.
block.table_tools.help_reject_invalid_ro: Off: fail the whole batch. On: report and exclude malformed rows (maximum 1,000 issues).
block.table_tools.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
